stories.headline: McCaffrey Sits Out the First Practice Down Under, and Shanahan Won't Say a Word
stories.read: Well pardner, the Niners held their first full practice in Melbourne and Christian McCaffrey never took the field for the part the newspapermen could see. Kyle Shanahan grinned and said he's technically in the future so he don't have to talk injuries yet, which is the slipperiest dodge I've heard since a fella sold me a lame mule in '24. Most likely this is just an old thoroughbred restin' before Thursday's opener against the Rams, so don't you go sellin' him for pennies. But Kaelon Black is the spare horse tied up behind him, he's free on the open range in near every outfit, and he costs you nothin' but a roster spot. Stake that claim tonight and sleep easy either way.

stories.headline: Kittle Walks Out of the Grave and Onto the Practice Field in Australia
stories.read: Eight months back George Kittle busted his Achilles in the wild card game, and Monday he was out there in Melbourne takin' reps like the man never got hurt. That's a resurrection, plain and simple, and he's trendin' toward suitin' up Thursday. Now hold up before you get greedy: nobody expects him to run his usual near-every-snap workload right out of the chute, so temper how high she can flood in Week 1. The real play is the price. Half the saloon wrote Kittle off in August and let him slide way past his worth, so if you grabbed him late you just struck a vein. Roster a cheap rental tight end for one ride as insurance and let Kittle ramp up on somebody else's dime.

stories.headline: Egbuka's Toe Is Talkin' Again, and Tampa's Whole Haul Is Sittin' There for Him
stories.read: Egbuka was out in warmups runnin' routes at Monday's practice, first real football he's done since that toe got rolled up in mid-August. Word out of Tampa still points to him goin' for the Bengals on the 13th, and here's what the greenhorns are missin': Mike Evans rode west to San Francisco, so there is no big fella standin' between Egbuka and the No. 1 job. He already took near a quarter of that team's throws as a rookie with Evans healthy. If somebody in your outfit is spooked by the word questionable and wants to swap horses cheap, you take that trade and you don't blink.
